Crossy Road is an endless arcade hopper video game developed by Australian studio Hipster Whale and released on November 20, 2014. 
Wikipedia

Gameplay and Mechanics
Objective: Guide a character as far as possible across a never-ending series of busy roads, train tracks, and rivers. 
YouTube
·Crossy Road
 +1
Controls: Tap or press forward to hop, and swipe or use arrow keys/WASD to move sideways or backward. 
Hazards: Getting hit by cars, struck by trains, falling into water, or lingering too long (which triggers a swooping eagle) results in an immediate game over.
